summary: Via Renewables, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the partial redemption of 209,437 shares of its 8.75% Series A Fixed-to-Floating Rate Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock at $25.00 per share plus accrued dividends of $0.25271/share, totaling approximately $5.24 million. The redemption date is May 20, 2026, and payment will be made through DTC and Equiniti Trust Company. This is a routine exercise of the issuer's redemption right, not a tender offer or corporate action triggered by external pressure. The company is returning capital to preferred shareholders. Watch for any subsequent redemptions or changes in capital structure.
